name: smwblocks-xy-overworld-position-blocks-version
title: XY Overworld Position Blocks, Version 4
description:
This block sets the player's X and Y position on the overworld, allowing you to warp to a new location after you leave the level.

This update fixes a bug in previous versions that failed to update level names (Thanks, Romi!), adds support for Luigi and gives the option to instantly warp to the overworld.
